children: According to ChainCatcher, trader Killa said Bitcoin continues to follow its four-year cycle despite the current cycle lasting longer. He noted that 81% of historical cycle indicators suggest BTC is nearing a macro bottom.
After Bitcoin broke below the $57,000 low, Killa said it could bottom in the $40,000-$55,000 range.

title: Trader Killa Says Bitcoin Is Near a Macro Bottom, With a Potential $40,000-$55,000 Range
